modmenu.summaryTranslation.mystclient: Purple client interface and visual settings.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.mystclien: Mist Visuals is a client-side mod with a purple interface and HUD, Visuals, Marks, Utilities, Streamer and Configs sections. Streamer Mode locally replaces displayed TAB names on this client only. Other visual modules will be added as they are implemented.
